name: How long does a typical drywall patching project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical drywall patching project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a drywall patching project varies depending on the size and complexity of the damage. Small repairs, such as nail holes or minor cracks, can often be completed in a few hours, including drying time for spackle or joint compound. Larger patches, especially those requiring multiple layers of compound and sanding, may take one to two days to ensure proper drying and a smooth finish before painting. We provide an estimated timeline during our initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small drywall patches can take a few hours. Larger or more complex repairs may take one to two days to allow for proper drying and finishing.
